content: My original Core One print fan is identical to the print fan included in the INDX upgrade.  Using the newer one for the print fan and the older one (after blowing it out) for the dock fan later on.
Take a second here to blow out that fan using compressed air.

The fan provided will be used in 5.59 (Dock Fan preparation). If you have one with a longer cable, you will need to use it later there instead. However, at least that fan is not being thrown around the chamber with the print head.
The fan already has an M3x25 screw that was attaching it before
